scenes.text: Format Converter turns vendor or general microscopy images into the Yokogawa-style TIFF names that spaCR Mask and Measure read directly. Open it from Data and batch runs. The central safety rule is preview first and convert second.

scenes.text: Layout describes whether images sit directly in the source, below well folders, or below plate and well folders; automatic detection is normally appropriate. Keep every Z plane is the lossless default. Max projection and first-plane mode explicitly discard planes. Plate names may be sequential or preserve source folders, and Resume validates field checkpoints before skipping them.
